vc_checking.summary: All three target witnesses are semantically proofable with the existing xizi singly-linked-list definitions and lemmas. The first entailment initializes the loop decomposition at the sentinel; the second advances it by one node; the return witness uses the null suffix to recompose the extended list and expose the sentinel-head representation. No annotation or seed-spec change is required.

vc_shape.pre_exists: xizi_sll_head hides the first data-node pointer
vc_shape.post_spatial: the current-node next cell at node=linklist_pre, an empty xizi_sllseg from the sentinel to itself, the unchanged data suffix, and the framed new-node cell

vc_shape.post_exists: next is the first pointer hidden by xizi_sll_head; l1a=nil; l1b=l

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first disjunct, unfold xizi_sll_head, and instantiate next with its hidden first pointer, l1a with nil, and l1b with l.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold xizi_sll_head/generic_sll_head. Keep the sentinel next field as the generated current-node cell, fold xizi_sllseg linklist_pre linklist_pre nil from emp and reflexivity, retain xizi_sll next l, and frame the disjoint linklist_node_pre field.
witnesses.pure_plan: The list equation reduces by simplification to cons linklist_pre l = cons linklist_pre l. PreH1 and PreH2 discharge the non-null conjuncts.
premise_discharge: The existential first pointer and its field cell come directly from unfolding xizi_sll_head.
The empty segment requires only linklist_pre=linklist_pre and emp.
The new-node field is preserved verbatim as a frame.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the initialization direction of the same traversal decomposition advanced by entail_wit_2 and consumed by return_wit_1.

vc_shape.pre_exists: xizi_sll next_2 l1b_2 hides next_2's successor and tail list
vc_shape.post_spatial: next_2's next cell and remaining xizi_sll suffix, an extended prefix segment ending at next_2, and the framed new-node field

vc_shape.post_exists: open l1b_2 as next_2::l0; choose next as next_2's successor, l1a=l1a_2++[node], and l1b=l0

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Select the first disjunct. Apply xizi_sll_not_zero to next_2 and l1b_2, obtaining successor next, tail l0, and l1b_2=next_2::l0. Choose l1a=l1a_2++[node] and l1b=l0.
witnesses.space_plan: Use xizi_sllseg_len1 on node->next_2, then xizi_sllseg_sllseg to append that singleton segment to the existing prefix. Preserve the exposed next_2 field and xizi_sll successor tail, and frame the new-node field.
witnesses.pure_plan: Rewrite PreH1 with l1b_2=next_2::l0 and normalize list append associativity to obtain cons linklist_pre l=(l1a_2++[node])++next_2::l0. PreH2 and PreH5 provide the required non-null facts; PreH4 is the premise of xizi_sll_not_zero.
premise_discharge: next_2 <> NULL is exactly PreH4 after normalizing NULL to 0.
node <> NULL is exactly PreH3 and discharges xizi_sllseg_len1.
All output cells and predicates partition resources already present in the antecedent.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the one-step traversal transition between the initialization and recomposition witnesses.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Use next=0 and xizi_sll_zero to derive l1b=nil. Build xizi_sll linklist_node_pre [linklist_node_pre], prepend node, then prepend the existing prefix segment. Rewrite the resulting address list with PreH1 to cons linklist_pre (l++[linklist_node_pre]); unfolding its leading sentinel node supplies the q required by the second disjunct (and is definitionally xizi_sll_head for the first disjunct).
witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_sll_zero to consume the null suffix as emp, xizi_sll_len1 to the new node's null next field, xizi_sll_cons to node->linklist_node_pre plus the singleton new-node list, and xizi_sllseg_sll to combine the prefix with that tail. Finally unfold the leading xizi_sll node to separate the sentinel field from the appended data-chain.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH4 rewrites next to NULL, so xizi_sll_zero yields l1b=nil. Substituting this in PreH1 and simplifying list append shows the recomposed full address list equals linklist_pre :: (l ++ [linklist_node_pre]). PreH2 and PreH3 discharge the non-null premises of xizi_sll_len1 and xizi_sll_cons.
premise_discharge: next=0 is PreH4 and lets xizi_sll_zero establish l1b=nil.
linklist_node_pre<>0 is PreH2 and node<>0 is PreH3.
The final head field and data-chain are obtained by unfolding the recomposed xizi_sll at its leading sentinel, not by inventing ownership.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This consumes the same prefix/current/suffix decomposition and reverses it after the two stores.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Expose the sentinel/data-chain boundary, maintain a prefix/current/suffix decomposition while advancing one node, and recompose it after appending the separately owned singleton node.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use the existing xizi_sll opening, singleton segment/list, segment concatenation, and segment-to-list lemmas; retain the new-node next cell as a frame until the final stores.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Normalize nil/cons/list-app equations, use loop-guard non-null facts for list opening, and use next=0 to force the terminal suffix list to nil.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses share one representation family and form consecutive phases of one loop invariant. Keeping them together preserves the decomposition/recomposition context; count 3 is within max_witnesses_per_group=12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove initialization by unfolding xizi_sll_head and choosing the empty prefix. Prove loop advancement by xizi_sll_not_zero, xizi_sllseg_len1, and xizi_sllseg_sllseg. Prove return by xizi_sll_zero, xizi_sll_len1, xizi_sll_cons, and xizi_sllseg_sll, then normalize the list equation and unfold the leading sentinel node into xizi_sll_head (or select the equivalent exposed-head second disjunct).
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The three witnesses are consecutive initialization, transition, and return obligations for the same prefix/current/suffix invariant and use one tightly coupled existing-lemma family. A single three-witness group is balanced and below the controller limit of 12.
